title: Notes from a video
summary: What one public video shows and says, with a few of its frames and what to learn from it.

asks.label: What should it learn from it?

text: Watch the video at [video] and take notes: what it shows, what is said, and what we could learn from it, each with the moment it happens. Keep a few frames worth learning from. If the video has no captions and its words cannot be made out, say so. Look in particular for: [learn]
